correctness.rationale: All 8! strict vertex filtrations were enumerated; descending links in a one-dimensional unfilled graph are cones exactly when they contain one earlier neighbor. The full downward-closed 492-face complex has an explicit 239-pair acyclic Hasse matching checked by a topological sort on all 492 nodes. Its only critical cells are one 0-cell and thirteen 3-cells, proving an integral wedge of thirteen 3-spheres; independent mod-two ranks (19,89,131) corroborate. Every one of 16 graph automorphisms is checked, and exact signed Lefschetz traces give the complete rational character on H3.

value.rationale: The minimal three-petal cactus containing two interchangeable triangles and one square is a natural first mixed-versus-uniform test. Grafting one square onto the known two-triangle friendship graph changes its thirteen 1-sphere summands into thirteen 3-spheres, while retaining multiplicity. The nontrivial full order-sixteen symmetry character cannot be inferred from the homotopy type and supplies motivated exact structural data for future mixed-cactus formulas. The scope is finite, not disguised as a family theorem.
